customize.name: Millhaven's Morning Plate
customize.desc: A classic Millhaven breakfast. Slices of mincemeat patty are heated through and served alongside fried eggs, sausages, and potatoes. Nutritious and hearty, this meal provides all the energy needed to power through a busy morning.

customize.name: Delicious Millhaven's Morning Plate
customize.desc: A classic Millhaven breakfast. Fresh from the oven, the rich aroma of savory meat and toasted char rises to meet you, instantly transforming morning drowsiness into a ravenous appetite. A brand new day should always begin with such a magnificent overture!
